source: development snapshot and fit parameters in protocol.json; no release audit rerun
dateSelection: For each separately fitted span: first, midpoint by stored-day index, last, minimum and maximum smoothed covariance norm. Deduplicate equal dates. Record actual dates in the evidence.
rationale: Carry the registered historical interval endpoint precision budget of 0.12 percentage points over to each coalition endpoint. Apply the same budget to means. Compare each seed against an independent four-times-larger ensemble. This is a proposed coalition gate until the registered study passes; failure blocks the candidate and never widens the budget.
candidateGate: Repeat the registered date-selection and error rule for every candidate fit, before staging. All subsets, seeds, means and both endpoints must pass. This does not waive the existing release verdict.

benchmark.machine: local deployment host, owner confirmed 16 GB installed and 6 GB available
